records.speaker: Original village officer
records.context: After the officer relays the chief's request, the player enters and confirms the promised words. Acceptance produces the clue followed by permission to use the village facilities on the next visit. A failed answer can lead to the notice that the chief has left.
records.source_Japanese: 『海に突き出た釣り鐘状の奇岩の名』
records.source_meaning: The promised word refers to the name of the bell-shaped rock jutting out into the sea.
records.english: They say it means "the name of the bell-shaped rock jutting out into the sea."
records.localization_note: Keep the bell-shaped rock together so the definite article leads directly into its noun phrase.
